newsitem.title: USA: McMoRan, MCN sell Cameron block.
newsitem.headline: McMoRan, MCN sell Cameron block.

text.p: McMoRan Oil & Gas Co said on Friday that it and MCN Energy Group Inc completed the sale of their interest in West Cameron Block 503 in the Gulf of Mexico to an undisclosed buyer for $7.2 million.

McMoRan, which had a 60 percent interest in the block, said it will recognize a $2.3 million gain in the second quarter of 1997, and will use its $2.9 million in proceeds to repay borrowings from MCN.

McMoRan said it found two natural gas reservoirs in the block, but that after reviewing the potential reserves and the costs of developing the field, it and MCN agreed to sell their interest rather than develop the field themselves.
The buyer is developing an adjacent block and can use the same platform to develop Block 503, McMoRan said.
